title: The Ghost of the Free Port Again
author: Sebastian Marchetti
blurb: Wren Kavanagh, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
